[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Carrot and Raisin Quinoa Pilaf: Cook quinoa with carrots, onions, and raisins, adding fresh herbs and lemon juice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Quinoa and Edamame Salad with Carrot-Ginger Dressing: Cook quinoa and edamame, mix with carrots and scallions, dressed with carrot juice, ginger, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Quinoa Stuffed Bell Peppers: Fill bell peppers with quinoa, black beans, carrots, and tomatoes, then bake.
